title: Time scrubber
blurb: A ring buffer of DOM frames. Scrub the interface back in time, leave motion trails, and restore a past moment, form values included.
question: Can a page keep past frames of an element and return to an earlier one, form values included?

openSnapshots.why: known: the page is a rewind buffer of ElementImage snapshots. It keeps one per changed element per frame for the seconds it can rewind and closes them as they leave the buffer.

waitsForPerson.why: its checks start when the reader scrolls down to the Live tests section (shared/on-screen.js)
